Information Security Policy

SEC-POL-002 • v3.0 • Effective 01 June 2026 • Owner: IT & Security

Access

Named accounts and multi-factor authentication are mandatory for production and confidential systems. Shared accounts are prohibited except for documented break-glass access.

Data handling

Customer banking, payroll and identity data are CONFIDENTIAL. Export requires manager approval and encryption.

Incidents

Suspected exposure must be reported within four hours to Priya Govender (EMP-008). Evidence must be preserved.

Retention

Access logs: 365 days. Financial evidence: seven years. Temporary exports: delete within 30 days.

Exception

INC-2026-017 records an unencrypted payroll export sent to an incorrect fictional address, breaching this policy.
